description: Vertex Consulting Group engagement library. Twelve past engagements with company profile, financial detail and project detail. Used for embedding-based retrieval. All entities are fictional.

engagement.title: Procurement consolidation and shared services design across 9 hospitals
engagement.scope: Spend cube across 9 sites covering Rs 41 Cr of addressable spend; supplier fragmentation analysis; shared services operating model for finance and procurement; 18-month roadmap with bottom-up benefits case.

outcome.results: 11 percent of addressable spend realised in year one. Shared services business case approved at Board in first submission.

win_themes: Single named partner on site two days a week for the full engagement
Spend cube delivered in week 3, not week 10 - early proof of value
Benefits case built bottom-up from supplier-level data, not benchmarks
records.msa_note: Standard terms. Named human reviewer required on all deliverables.

engagement.title: Patient throughput and theatre utilisation diagnostic
engagement.scope: Outpatient scheduling redesign, theatre utilisation analysis and discharge process mapping across 4 flagship sites. Throughput model calibrated on 24 months of the client's own admissions data.

outcome.results: Theatre utilisation up 14 percentage points across 4 sites in 10 months. Average discharge lead time reduced 31 percent.

win_themes: Throughput model calibrated on the client's own data, not industry benchmarks
Clinician-led design sessions rather than consultant-led workshops
Committed to a measured throughput uplift, not an estimated one
records.msa_note: Standard terms. Named human reviewer required on all deliverables.

engagement.title: Post-acquisition integration of 6 diagnostic centres
engagement.scope: Integration of billing, procurement and patient administration across acquired centres. Synergy case validated against the acquisition model. Integration control tower from week one.

outcome.results: Priced 22 percent above the winning bidder. Client feedback: approach was strong but the team was seen as too senior-heavy for the budget.

win_themes: Integration control tower operating from week one
Synergy case validated against the acquisition model

engagement.title: Procurement diagnostic and quick-win capture sprint
engagement.scope: Eight-week procurement diagnostic across 5 sites with a parallel quick-win capture sprint. Procurement data cleansed and handed back as a reusable client asset.

outcome.results: Quick wins funded the remainder of the programme within the first quarter. Rs 6.2 Cr annualised savings identified, Rs 2.1 Cr captured in-engagement.

win_themes: Quick-win sprint funded the rest of the programme within the first quarter
Procurement data cleansed and handed back as a reusable client asset

engagement.title: Shared services and operating model redesign
engagement.scope: Finance and HR shared services design, location strategy across three cities, transition roadmap sequenced around the financial close calendar. Location strategy grounded in a live talent-availability study.

outcome.results: Rs 22 Cr annual run-rate cost reduction identified. Transition completed on schedule across two waves.

win_themes: Location strategy grounded in a live talent-availability study, not desk research
Transition roadmap sequenced around the client's financial close calendar
records.msa_note: MSA signed 2021 prohibits processing of client material by third-party automated systems. Renegotiation pending with Legal.

engagement.title: Middle-office target operating model and vendor consolidation
engagement.scope: Middle-office process redesign, vendor landscape rationalisation from 14 providers to 5, target operating model with a build-versus-buy assessment.

outcome.results: Vendor spend reduced 28 percent. Trade break rate reduced by a third within six months.

win_themes: Outcome-linked fee tied to realised vendor savings
Build-versus-buy assessment run as an open book with the client's own technology team

engagement.title: Multi-site procurement transformation
engagement.scope: Direct and indirect spend analysis across 11 plants, category strategy development, supplier negotiation support, category playbooks handed over for client-run wave two.

outcome.results: Rs 112 Cr addressable spend analysed. 8.4 percent realised savings in year one. Client ran wave two independently.

win_themes: Outcome-linked fee tied to realised savings, not identified savings
Category playbooks handed over so the client could run wave two alone

engagement.title: Operations diagnostic and throughput improvement
engagement.scope: Line-level throughput diagnostic across 4 plants, OEE baselining, bottleneck analysis, 90-day improvement plan.

outcome.results: OEE improved 9 percentage points on the two priority lines within the 90-day window.

win_themes: Diagnostic sequenced so the first plant produced results before the fourth was scoped
Shop-floor supervisors trained to sustain the measurement after handover

engagement.title: Operating model diagnostic and Board-ready transformation roadmap
engagement.scope: Diagnostic across clinical support services, prioritised transformation roadmap, two Board presentations. Every recommendation costed and owner-assigned before submission.

outcome.results: Roadmap adopted in full by the Trust Board at first presentation.

win_themes: Roadmap written in the Board's own decision language, not consulting language
Every recommendation costed and owner-assigned before submission
records.msa_note: Public procurement terms require prior written approval for any automated tooling. No approval currently on file.

engagement.title: Network design and cost-to-serve analysis
engagement.scope: Distribution network optimisation, cost-to-serve model at SKU-customer level, service level redesign.

outcome.results: Client in-housed the analysis using its own global capability centre. Feedback: the model was strong but the client concluded it could build and maintain it internally.

win_themes: Cost-to-serve model at SKU-customer level

engagement.title: Store operations cost structure and back-office shared services
engagement.scope: Store-level cost-to-operate analysis across 190 stores, back-office consolidation design, indirect procurement review.

outcome.results: Rs 34 Cr annual cost reduction identified, 62 percent implemented within 12 months.

win_themes: Cost-to-operate analysed at store level, so regional managers could act on their own numbers
Back-office design validated in two pilot regions before firm-wide rollout

engagement.title: Shared services design and field operations productivity
engagement.scope: Design of a shared services centre for finance, HR administration and asset management reporting. Field crew productivity baselining across 40 sites.

outcome.results: Shared services centre live in 7 months. Field crew productive hours up 12 percent.

win_themes: Shared services scoped around reporting cycles rather than org charts
Field productivity baselined with crews present, which removed the usual disputes about the data
